title: Lightning Hit Apollo 12 Twice 52 Seconds After Launch

scenes.text: Lightning hit a Moon rocket twice in the first 52 seconds.
Apollo 12 lifted off in the rain in 1969, and a bolt hit it at 36 seconds.
Alarms lit up and all three fuel cells shut down.
Then a second strike hit at 52 seconds.
Flight controller John Aaron remembered one odd switch from a simulation. He told them to flip it.
Power came back, and the crew still reached the Moon.
Two lightning strikes, and they went anyway.

description:
Lightning hit the Apollo 12 rocket twice in its first 52 seconds. The crew lost power, but one flight controller remembered a single switch that saved the mission.
The astronauts still walked on the Moon.
Would you have kept flying?
first_comment: Would you have stayed in the capsule after the first strike?
